data.about: A parabola through two supports A, B and the apex C — the funicular shape of a uniformly distributed load. The tangents at the supports meet on the centreline exactly 2h below the closing string; parallels to them through the ends of the load line locate the pole o. The midpoint rule (a parabola point lies midway between secant and tangent on any vertical) refines the funicular polygon from half-span to quarters to eighths, and dividing the two tangents into equal parts yields the enclosing tangent polygon of the same curve.

steps.title: Tension
